questions.question: A LiteRT file converts successfully. What must happen before claiming NPU latency?
options: Run it on the named device, verify execution placement and measure the stated request boundary.
Divide CPU latency by the weight compression ratio.
Assume every operator uses the NPU.
questions.explanation: Conversion proves a converter accepted the graph. Device execution, fallback behavior and end-to-end latency require direct measurement.
optionFeedback: Conversion proves a converter accepted the graph. Device execution, fallback behavior and end-to-end latency require direct measurement.
CPU timing and compression ratio cannot establish NPU placement or latency. Inspect delegated operations on the actual device.
Conversion can leave unsupported operations on CPU. Confirm partitioning and measure the whole prediction boundary.
